params.body:
Follow-ups for members after #169 and #170.

**Account page**
- **Change plan →** under the plan name, linking to the plans. Team members do not see it, since they already have the top plan.
- **Your agent** was two code blocks and a paragraph. It is now **In your AI tool**: one sentence and **Connect your AI tool →**, which opens `/connect`. That page already has a card per tool (Claude Code, Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor) with copy buttons and the steps in order.
- **Keys** is renamed **Keys for scripts**, which is what keys are for now that an AI tool signs in by itself.

**Menu (members)**
- **AI tools** opens `/connect`, next to Your plan.
- **Reading room** is gone from the top right. It linked to the page the logo already opens, and for a member that page is the reading room.

**Footer**
- The page links follow the same rule as the menu. Members see Your plan and AI tools instead of Services and Pricing.
- The two link columns are centred in the middle third of the footer.

Tests: 354 passing. Screenshots taken locally, logged out and logged in as a test reader.
params.title: Account: Change plan, AI tools on their own page; menu and footer follow the member
